classifications.title: MCP isError and execution status semantics
evidence: MCP tools/call separates ProtocolSucceeded from ToolSucceeded.
Explicit isError=true is ToolReturnedError and records ToolExecutionFailed with bounded context instead of ToolExecutionCompleted.
Explicit isError=false and omitted isError are ToolSucceeded only for complete results.
resultType=complete and absent backward-compatible resultType are accepted; input_required fails closed as unsupported in v0.
Protocol errors, timeouts, unknown resultType values, input_required results, and malformed results have distinct bounded execution_status values.
classifications.next_action: Use this closed result-semantics contract as the baseline for MCP-S2.

classifications.title: Tool-level Brownie safety policy
evidence: Compiled Mode Pack MCP tool policy now encodes side_effect, approval, idempotency, and retry per tool.
Legacy string tool-name entries remain readable compatibility input but compile as legacy_unclassified with unknown/prohibited safety policy and are denied by Runtime.
RuntimePermissionGate requires mcp_tool_access, server/tool allow-list membership, and executable structured Brownie safety policy before tools/call.
In v0, approval-free MCP execution is limited to read_only, approval=not_required, idempotency=safe, and retry other than prohibited.
Local and external mutation, destructive, unknown, approval-required, and legacy-unclassified tools fail closed until later approval binding phases.
classifications.next_action: Use this closed policy baseline for MCP-S3 annotation provenance and MCP-S4 approval binding.

classifications.title: MCP tool annotation provenance
evidence: tools/list parses bounded MCP annotations readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, and openWorldHint.
Catalog entries carry bounded annotations plus an annotation_fingerprint, and the catalog fingerprint source includes those values.
Mode-resolved task-pinned MCP catalog evidence includes annotation payloads and fingerprints without storing raw schemas, responses, paths, secrets, or environment values.
tools/call rechecks live catalog fingerprints and per-tool annotation fingerprints before server execution, so annotation drift fails closed.
Invalid known annotation field types fail closed during catalog admission.
Contradictory or open-world annotations narrow approval-free read-only execution before tools/call; descriptions and annotation prose are never authority.
classifications.next_action: Use this closed narrowing-only annotation provenance baseline for MCP-S4 approval binding.

classifications.title: Tool-level approval binding
evidence: Approval-required MCP tools/call execution is bound to a Runtime-materialized approval fingerprint before server execution.

The approval binding includes task id, run id, normalized MCP tool id, server id, tool name, request fingerprint, task-pinned catalog/schema/annotation provenance, server config identity, and structured Brownie MCP safety policy.
Missing, stale, consumed, malformed, mismatched, or over-broad approval evidence denies before tools/call.
Matching runtime-ledgered approval evidence permits the exact invocation and task-scoped replay reuses completed evidence without a duplicate tools/call.

Approval evidence cannot override mcp_tool_access, server/tool allow-list membership, legacy-unclassified policy, prohibited retry, destructive or unknown policy, annotation narrowing, or catalog drift.
classifications.next_action: Use this closed approval-binding baseline for MCP-S5 runtime input/output schema validation.

classifications.title: Runtime input/output schema validation
evidence: MCP input and output schema fingerprints and bounded summaries are task-pinned.
Actual arguments are currently checked only as objects, and structured output is not yet validated against a bounded schema subset.
classifications.next_action: Close in MCP-S5 with bounded JSON Schema subset validation and fail-closed unsupported keywords.

classifications.title: MCP secret reference contract
evidence: MCP stdio launches clear ambient inherited environment.
Runtime does not yet expose a minimal SecretResolver contract for scoped ephemeral MCP child environment injection.
classifications.next_action: Close in MCP-S6 without implementing Vault, KMS, Secret Manager, tenant secret storage, or admin UI.

classifications.title: MCP server executable identity
evidence: MCP stdio command must be absolute, rejects PATH lookup, clears env, uses neutral cwd, and reaps request-scoped child processes.
Executable content identity is not yet fixed and rechecked before tools/list and tools/call.
classifications.next_action: Close in MCP-S7 by pinning executable hash evidence without ledgering raw paths or binary content.

classifications.title: P1 transport and task reevaluation
evidence: Streamable HTTP, remote MCP servers, OAuth, MCP Apps, Roots, Elicitation, Sampling, long-running tasks, and public registries are explicitly outside this P0 campaign.
classifications.next_action: Reevaluate only after stdio MCP safety closure is complete.
